inferred_constraints.description: Order creation and payment processing must reside in the same service to guarantee transactional consistency.
Supplier and Procurement Management must be decoupled from Inventory and Storage Management to allow flexibility in sourcing.
Menu, Product and Experience Design Process should be closely integrated with Kitchen Production and Service Preparation Process to ensure consistency.
Reservation, Table and Capacity Management Process should be aligned with Dine-In Service Delivery and Guest Experience Process to optimize guest experience.
Quality, Food Safety and Risk Management Process must be integrated with Supplier and Procurement Management Process to ensure compliance.
Marketing, Loyalty and CRM Process should be linked with Reservation, Table and Capacity Management Process to enhance customer engagement.

final_bsp.user_constraints:
[Iteration 1]:
Order creation and payment processing must reside in the same service to guarantee transactional consistency.

systems_analysis.description: This system is responsible for managing the entire lifecycle of order creation, payment processing, and financial compliance. It ensures transactional consistency across kitchen production, premium take-away, delivery fulfillment, and dine-in service processes. The system also handles feedback records and financial statements, providing a comprehensive view of financial health and customer satisfaction.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: While core financial management can be supported by existing ERP solutions, the integration with specific order and service processes requires significant customization.

market_options.name: SAP S/4HANA
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers robust financial management capabilities with customization options for order processing.

market_options.name: Oracle NetSuite
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides comprehensive financial and order management features with flexibility for customization.

market_options.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365
market_options.fit_rationale: Supports financial operations with the ability to integrate custom order processing workflows.

systems_analysis.description: This system focuses on managing customer profiles, marketing campaigns, and loyalty programs. It aims to enhance customer relationships through targeted marketing efforts and personalized loyalty initiatives, leveraging CRM processes to drive customer engagement and retention.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's requirements align well with existing CRM and marketing automation solutions available in the market.

market_options.name: Salesforce
market_options.fit_rationale: A leading CRM platform with extensive marketing and loyalty management capabilities.

market_options.name: HubSpot
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers integrated marketing, sales, and CRM tools suitable for customer engagement.

market_options.name: Adobe Experience Cloud
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides comprehensive marketing and customer experience management solutions.

systems_analysis.description: This system is designed to handle the planning and execution of events and B2B interactions. It manages invoices and event plans, ensuring seamless coordination and financial tracking for business events and partnerships.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: While event management software can cover core functionalities, specific B2B processes may require tailored solutions.

market_options.name: Cvent
market_options.fit_rationale: Specializes in event management with options for customization.

market_options.name: Eventbrite
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers event planning and management features with integration capabilities.

systems_analysis.description: This system manages reservations, table allocations, and overall capacity planning. It ensures efficient use of space and resources, optimizing the guest experience through effective reservation handling and table management.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's functionalities are well-supported by existing reservation and table management software solutions.

market_options.name: OpenTable
market_options.fit_rationale: Widely used for reservation and table management in the hospitality industry.

market_options.name: Resy
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides comprehensive reservation management features with a focus on guest experience.

systems_analysis.description: This system oversees inventory control, storage management, and compliance with quality and food safety standards. It ensures that inventory records are accurate and that compliance logs are maintained to meet regulatory requirements.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: While inventory management solutions exist, the integration with compliance and risk management processes necessitates customization.

market_options.name: SAP Integrated Business Planning
market_options.fit_rationale: Supports inventory management with options for compliance tracking.

market_options.name: Oracle SCM Cloud
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers inventory and supply chain management with compliance features.

systems_analysis.description: This system is responsible for the design and management of menus, recipes, and overall product offerings. It supports the creative process of developing new culinary experiences while ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's focus on creative design and alignment with strategic goals requires a bespoke solution tailored to specific business needs.

systems_analysis.description: This system manages supplier profiles and procurement processes, ensuring efficient sourcing and supplier relationship management. It supports the procurement lifecycle from supplier selection to contract management.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's requirements are well-covered by existing procurement and supplier management solutions.

market_options.name: SAP Ariba
market_options.fit_rationale: A comprehensive procurement solution with supplier management capabilities.

market_options.name: Coupa
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers procurement and supplier management features with a focus on spend optimization.

systems_analysis.description: This system supports strategic planning and governance processes, managing strategic plans and ensuring alignment with organizational goals. It provides tools for strategic analysis, decision-making, and performance tracking.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's strategic focus and need for alignment with unique organizational goals necessitate a custom-built solution.
